_comment: Each provider's known availability window on ghcr.io/anchore/grype-db/data/<name>:<YY-MM-DD>. 'start' is confirmed via the GitHub Packages API package creation timestamp (not just what's currently tagged); discovery still confirms a tag actually exists before exporting it. 'end' is set only once a provider's removal has been deliberately confirmed (upstream vunnel/grype-db dropped it, not just an outage) - until then cmd/changelog carries its last known data forward through ordinary gaps. Once past 'end', cmd/changelog stops carrying it forward and drops it from the tree, but a fresh ref after 'end' always wins regardless (in case the removal was recorded in error).
